prompt:
Build a physically causal tractor drivetrain with a hydrostatic continuously variable transmission. The system must include a governed prime mover, a variable-displacement hydraulic pump, a closed hydraulic loop with charge-flow and pressure protection, hydraulic motors that drive both the front and rear axles, a finite-mass tractor body, four tire--soil contacts, and an implement that applies a physical field load. Hydraulic pressure and flow must transmit power from the prime mover through the pump and motors to the driven wheels.

Use closed-loop control of the measured tractor speed by varying pump displacement so that the vehicle follows a distance-indexed speed command. Read distance_breakpoints_m, target_velocity_kph, and engine_speed_rpm from MATLAB base-workspace variables. The two command vectors must have equal length and the distance breakpoints must be strictly increasing. Support target speeds from 0 to 4 km/h and engine speeds from 1800 to 2000 rpm.

Across the declared operating range, the tractor must track the commanded speed without prescribed vehicle motion, remain dynamically stable from a cold start, keep hydraulic pressure and flow finite, and preserve the causal path from speed error through the variable pump and hydraulic transmission to vehicle motion. Both driven axles must deliver physical effort, and changes in the declared inputs must affect the corresponding hydraulic and vehicle behavior.

Log three Timeseries named speed_control, hydraulic_state, and drivetrain_effort for the complete simulation interval. speed_control contains [target speed, measured speed, pump displacement] in [km/h, km/h, cm^3/rev]. hydraulic_state contains [loop high pressure, main-pump flow, front-motor speed, rear-motor speed] in [bar, m^3/s, rpm, rpm]. drivetrain_effort contains [engine speed, main-pump torque, front-motor torque, rear-motor torque] in [rpm, N*m, N*m, N*m]. Every channel must be measured from the same causal physical simulation.

Save the completed model as cand_XFLUID07.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XFLUID07.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
